Smoke Outlook for
Hidden Valley Prescribed Fire

Additional smoke modeling output can be found at the BlueSky Playground Dispersion Results.

Recent Air Quality in Area

Shown below is the recently measured air quality index (AQI) in the area. The map shows the location of the burn and the most recent daily AQI for nearby temporary and permanent monitors. Hover over a monitor of interest and click the name to access additional real-time air quality information and measurements from the last 7 days. Lastly, the AQI forecasts for today and tomorrow can be turned on by selecting the layer in the upper right of the map. Additional information for your area can be found on the Fire and Smoke Map and EPA AirNow Map. The forecasted AQI for areas downwind of the planned burn is Good.

Air Quality Index (AQI) Actions to Protect Yourself
Good None.
Moderate Unusually sensitive individuals should consider limiting prolonged or heavy exertion.
USG People within Sensitive Groups should reduce prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion.
Unhealthy People within Sensitive Groups should avoid all physical outdoor activity.
Very Unhealthy Everyone should avoid prolonged or heavy exertion.
Hazardous Everyone should avoid any outdoor activity.

Note: Generally, smoke sensitive people are kids and older adults along with those who have cardiovascular or respiratory conditions.

For more smoke and health information: https://airnow.gov/

Modeled Smoke Dispersion

Below are the smoke modeling outputs for the day of the planned burn. The maps below show the daily average concentrations (top panel) and daily average visual range (bottom panel) for 2025-03-04. Zoom in/out on each of the interactive maps to view particular features.

Average Daily Smoke Conditions on 2025-03-04: The average daily smoke conditions are helpful for concerns related to public health. Select ‘Population’ to see the number of people in each census tract surrounding the planned burn.

Maximum Hourly Impact to Visual Range on 2025-03-04: The maximum hourly impact to visual range shows estimated smoke impacts to visibility in the area. This map is useful for identifying potential impacts to visibility on roadways or other areas.

Meteorological Conditions

The predicted weather data for this area, including fire behavior and smoke parameters can be found on the Fire Weather Dashboard. The spot weather forecast indicates there is not potential for superfog formation in the overnight hours.
